title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON + delimiter/token ordering
author: Jordan Lee
release_notes: Fixes several edge cases in SSE streaming that could emit partial JSON events with incorrect delimiter ordering or split JSON tokens across chunks. Improves robustness of OpenAI-compat streaming adapter and adds e2e tests. No API surface breaking changes.
body: Context: Customers reported rare but actionable corruption of streaming partial-JSON payloads when using the OpenAI-compat endpoint and SSE streaming. Root cause: the framer emitted delimiter tokens and token/event boundaries in an order that could split JSON tokens across chunk boundaries. This manifested as broken partial JSON objects on the client (e.g. '{\"choices\": [ { \"delta\": {\"content\": \"{\\\"incomplete\\\":}\" } } ]}') and also caused the TS SDK streaming decoder to drop events. Motivation: streaming stability is critical for low-latency applications and tool/function calling flows that rely on partial JSON for structured output. Changes: 1) Rework the SSE framer to buffer until logical token boundaries are available or to emit a guaranteed delimiter ordering: event delimiter ("event:"), data delimiter ("data:"), and terminal end-of-chunk token. The framer now preserves token atomicity for JSON string / object tokens by using a small reassembly buffer and a token-aware boundary detector. 2) Update openai_compat adapter so that function/tool-calling and structured output events are emitted in the expected order (meta/event header first, then JSON payload chunks, then "\n\n" terminator). This fixes ordering mismatches with OpenAI clients that parse by delimiter sequence. 3) Improve backpressure/chunking logic to avoid splitting multibyte UTF-8 sequences and to prefer emitting larger stable tokens when under low-latency SLOs. 4) Add regression and e2e tests (unit streaming framer tests, TS client decoder integration, and a Go e2e that simulates slow network chunking). 5) Add diagnostics and metrics (sse.frag_reassembled_count and sse.malformed_events) to detect regressions in production. Testing/CI: Reproduced the reported failure with a fuzz harness, added deterministic cases to avoid flakiness, and re-ran CI. One flaky test in streaming-ts was fixed by making the decoder tolerant of trailing whitespace in partial chunks. Impact and compatibility: Backwards-compatible for consumers (no change to external API). Fix closes ENG-1234 and reduces customer incidents related to structured-output streaming. Rollout: merged to main and will be cherry-picked to release/2025-02 for a hotfix channel.

review_comments: Alex Kim: Can you add a note explaining the token boundary detector algorithm? Right now it's a bit magical when reading the framer code. - Addressed in 2nd commit with detailed comments and a small helper (token_boundary.go)

Priya Patel: The openai_compat change looks good; double-checked that function-calling events still include the correct name/order. Please add an e2e that exercises a tool call with partial JSON response. - Added in e2e test (partial_json_e2e_test.go)
Marco Santos: Found a flake in the TS test where trailing newline caused decoder to emit an extra empty event. Fixed by tolerating trailing whitespace and improved test harness. - Fix included

Elena Ruiz (QA): Verified deterministic reproducer reproduces the bug and fails on the old framer, passes with this branch. Also validated metrics are emitted when the buffer reassembles a split token.
ci_summary: Initial CI: 1 failing flaky test in sdk-typescript streaming unit test. After fix in streaming.ts and addition of deterministic e2e tests, full CI passed on rerun. Coverage: +0.6% in runtime/streaming. Lint: ok. Bench: negligible perf impact; small CPU overhead for token reassembly under extreme fragmentation but within SLOs.
notes_for_release: Fix SSE partial-JSON ordering and token-splitting bugs for streaming endpoints; improves reliability of tool/function calling and structured output over streaming. Monitoring: look for sse.malformed_events -> should drop to zero after rollout.
post_merge_actions: Cherry-pick to release/2025-02, notify support and SDK teams to cut micro-patches for older releases. Keep the e2e harness enabled in nightly fuzz runs for 2 weeks.
